src/agent_runtime/resource_authorization_review.py

Python · Tier A

Reviewed catalog authorization revisions (2026-10-29).

Details

Identity alternatives, shared CRUD discriminators, generated endpoint paths, operation schemas and supported lifecycle surfaces are pinned together. A future addition/change requires reviewing its binding before updating this snapshot. These hashes grant no authority; they prevent unclassified catalog expansion.

Follow-up review: task scratchpad naming, advisory memory assessment, typed inference profiles/builds, host-bound GPU power control, and finished-job deletion. Object selectors remain exact; unaddressed actions require collection access.

Attachment review (2026-11-02): read-only context_id alternatives, explicit legacy text decoding, bounded archive/materialization actions, scoped Vision image/page identities, and the additive Vision inference connection role. Path grants cannot match attachment IDs; document/page ownership is rechecked by the reader.

Workspace/Knowledge review (2026-11-08): relative source paths remain scoped to the owning conversation and gateway, including both move operands. Commands and unaddressed operations require collection access. Knowledge grants select exact references or imported context IDs; searches require collection access.
